mirrors: Compatibility copies exist under skeleton/ai/agents/jeeves and retain current byte parity. Approved native host/worker authority remains canonical skeleton/jeeves. Copy parity grants no ownership cutover or promotion.
scope: Actual libretro C ABI execution of operator-installed hash-approved native cores in isolated bubblewrap subprocesses; no uploaded Python, arbitrary library path, firmware download, hardware-compatibility fabrication or model-provider boundary
activation: Canonical registry resolves/revalidates typed approved cores. Host hash-pins private library, all approved system assets, worker/protocol code and content. Readonly canonical content pins use verified hardlinks; writable/cross-device content copies require aggregate 64 MiB and actual free-disk admission. Worker rehashes native library before dlopen and requires exact ABI symbols. No unsafe sandbox fallback. The fixed root-owned /usr/bin/python3 system installation is used instead of a managed virtual environment. Host and worker independently hash its resolved binary; actual CPython version/implementation receipt binds the final environment digest before any episode.
isolation: bubblewrap unshares network/PID/IPC/user namespaces, strips environment, exposes readonly runtime libraries/approved core/approved content/BIOS plus private temp/save directories, and dies with its parent. Process address-space/file/CPU limits supplement host wall-clock deadlines. Trusted native libraries remain native code; these boundaries are not a claim that arbitrary hostile libraries can be safely installed.

interfaces.factory: create_emulator_environment(target_id, core_id, expected_registry_digest, content, rom_source, filename, max_steps, frames_per_step, timeout_seconds, cancelled)
interfaces.learning: EmulatorEnvironment spec/reset/step/snapshot/restore/preview/close exposes 22 finite joypad and 9 keyboard actions, actual measured pixels/audio; visual exploration is not game-success proof
interfaces.controller: input_step accepts bounded four-port vectors; native worker captures core-supplied RETRO_ENVIRONMENT_SET_CONTROLLER_INFO and SET_INPUT_DESCRIPTORS with explicit status per port, and refuses a nonstandard device when the core explicitly excludes it. Host validates evidence, hashes the profile into the environment identity and exposes it to a below-view semantic controller deck. Core announcements do not certify physical controller compatibility.
interfaces.native: Actual reset, retro_run, serialize/unserialize, bounded memory reads and controller callbacks; RGB1555/RGB565/XRGB8888 software framebuffer conversion produces actual rgb24 pixels
interfaces.content: Cartridge bytes are bounded; large authorized CD/multifile sources materialize through canonical governed readers into immutable private content roots. Worker receives only readonly local paths and verified manifests, never arbitrary artifact URIs or credentials Operator-approved FBNeo/DOSBoxPure ZIP content remains opaque only after canonical archive CRC/extent/path/expansion inspection. The actual native ABI must independently declare block_extract before ZIP loading; archive filenames never execute uploaded host source.
interfaces.ipc: Length-prefixed strict bounded JSON metadata plus individually length/hash-bound binary blocks; worker/native stdout is separate from protocol; request IDs and source identities remain exact
interfaces.policy_actions: The live learning spec.actions contains only the31 finite joypad/keyboard primitives accepted by step(action). The controller_input transcript marker is not a policy action and never maps to an invented no-op.
interfaces.controller_traces: Rich controller vectors remain available through input_step/input_frame_step and capture_controller_trace. A capture with an exact validated controller tape explicitly extends only its offline trace descriptor with controller_input, and labels that action namespace controller_tape_only_not_policy_dispatch. The live policy descriptor remains unchanged, so ordinary exact-descriptor policy ingestion cannot treat the opaque marker as a dispatchable action.

integrity: Registry/core/firmware/options/content/host-worker-protocol/Python identities bind the policy environment. Current registry/source authority is checked around native commands. Snapshots bind exact opaque native state, frame, controller, cursor and identity and require native unserialize success; no caller booleans grant promotion authority. Core-reported controller options, legends and routing verdict are separately bounded and validated, then their digest is pinned into the native episode identity and transition receipts; phantom inputs through none ports fail closed. Live finite-policy actions and richer recorded controller inputs have distinct descriptor action catalogs. Rich controller traces retain exact native runtime/frame/input/source identities and explicit tape-only lineage; they do not grant replay or policy dispatch authority for a marker without its actual control vector.
failure: Missing core/symbol/BIOS, failed sandbox activation, unsupported hardware framebuffer/pixel format, corrupt content/state/protocol, callback excess, core crash/shutdown, timeout and cancellation produce explicit errors and retire the worker. Unsupported callbacks return false, never invented success. Malformed/overlong native controller metadata or advertised exclusion of a requested nonstandard device fails activation.
limitations: Libretro has no universal game-score/health or RNG seed control. Reset invokes actual native reset; a seed labels the episode without claiming control over every core's RNG. Device compatibility, deterministic reset, game mastery and acceptance remain unverified. A bounded metadata/controller regression test is supplied; no live native core, ROM or CI run is claimed in this change. Operational snapshots refuse state/frame combinations exceeding the existing 8 MiB JSON boundary before native serialization; the ABI 64 MiB transport limit is not end-to-end persistence capacity. Large readonly content uses private hardlink pins and proportional streaming SHA work without per-actor disc copies; writable or cross-device large content explicitly refuses activation. Readonly owner-managed files are never mutated by the backend; arbitrary operator mutation of an already approved inode is outside this data boundary.

learning_telemetry.actual_source: unmodified approved native libretro RGB24 framebuffer and stereo S16LE output
guarantees: No fabricated game score, health, win or semantic object recognition
Finite normalized frame and audio features are measured from real native callbacks
Checkpoint restore and independent replay required before candidate Q updates in deep training laboratory
Twenty-four finite native signal dimensions per actual worker-emitted observation including 12 paired-frame/audio changes
limitations: Missing output is reported as zero signal, not proof of silence in the game
Spatial edge and entropy probes sample pixels and are not render-quality certificates
Hardware compatibility remains unverified until actual native sessions
Cross-video-frame geometry change produces zero motion channels instead of fabricating vector correspondence

time_correlations.measurements: prev real framebuffer versus actual current frame; prev native S16LE chunk versus actual current chunk
time_correlations.coordinate_basis: normalized native pixel coordinates, 4 quadrant movement energy
time_correlations.semantics: numerical frame-and-audio transition probes, not segmentation, optical flow vectors, scene understanding, music transcription or gameplay outcomes
